waivers_description: Waivers of the project (.jgates/waivers.json): list them, waive a finding of the last validation until a date with a reason, or remove a waiver.
waivers_option_finding: add: fingerprint of the finding to waive, as shown in the text result (12 digits after jgf1: or any unique prefix); may repeat.
waivers_option_run: add: the run the findings come from (default: the last validation of the workspace).
waivers_option_until: add: the date the waiver stops applying, YYYY-MM-DD (required; today or later).
waivers_option_reason: add: why the finding is waived (required; 3 to 300 characters).
waivers_option_yes: add: write without asking after showing the entry.
waivers_missing_subcommand_fix: Use: jgates waivers list | add --finding <fingerprint> --until <date> --reason "<text>" | remove <id>.
waivers_unknown_subcommand_fix: Use: jgates waivers list | add | remove.
waivers_unexpected_argument_fix: Check the command with jgates help.
waivers_read_only: Waivers cannot be changed in governed (read-only) mode: the rules come from the CI policy ({env} is set).
waivers_read_only_fix: Change the waivers in the CI policy, or run without the policy variable to edit this project's file.
waivers_confirmation_required: There is no terminal to ask for confirmation and --yes was not given: nothing was written.
waivers_confirmation_required_fix: Run again with --yes to write the entry, or with --json.
waivers_refused_waiver_until_past_fix: Give today or a later date.
waivers_refused_waiver_reason_invalid_fi: Give --reason with 3 to 300 characters and no control characters.
waivers_refused_waiver_finding_required_: Give --finding <fingerprint> (the text result shows a short one for each finding).
waivers_refused_waiver_finding_not_found: Check the fingerprint against the run, or give --run <run id>.
waivers_refused_waiver_finding_ambiguous: {finding} starts more than one finding. Candidates: {candidates}
Give a longer prefix of one of them.
waivers_refused_waiver_finding_not_waiva: A finding needs a fingerprint and a file; a result stored by an old version may have neither.
waivers_refused_waiver_finding_informati: The finding {rule} is informational: it does not block the validation, so there is nothing to waive.
Waive only findings that block; an informational finding is shown and counted, and cannot be waived.
waivers_refused_waiver_already_exists_fi: Remove it first with jgates waivers remove {id}, or leave it as it is.
waivers_refused_waiver_id_required_fix: See the ids with jgates waivers list.
waivers_refused_waiver_not_found_fix: See the ids with jgates waivers list.
waivers_refused_waiver_file_invalid: {file} cannot be read ({place}): {problem}. It was not rewritten.
waivers_refused_waiver_file_invalid_fix: Fix the file by hand (it must hold a list or an object with "waivers"), then try again.
waivers_refused_waiver_file_changed: The waiver file changed since it was read: nothing was written.
waivers_refused_waiver_file_unsafe_fix: The waiver file must be a regular file inside the project.
waivers_refused_waiver_write_failed_fix: Check the permissions of the project folder and try again.
waivers_refused_waiver_run_not_found_fix: See the runs with jgates history.
waivers_refused_waiver_no_run: This workspace has no finished validation to take a finding from.
waivers_text_no_run: There is no finished validation yet: the waivers were not compared with any findings.
waivers_text_cause_count_changed: the number of findings in the file changed
waivers_text_matched: waived {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} in the last validation
waivers_text_unmatched: matched nothing in the last validation
waivers_text_preview: Entry to add to {file} (findings of run {run}):
waivers_text_incomplete_check: Note: a waiver never makes a check pass; a check that did not complete stays that way.
